title: Get Started with Teal - Teal Webinar - December 11 2023
description:
Job searching these days feels like a full-time job.
However, project managing your job search will keep you organized and on top of every resume you submit.

In the final webinar of 2023, Leah Dillon, Teal's Recruiter and Social Media Manager, will guide you through the process of setting up the Teal Resume Builder and Job Tracker so you can manage your job search with ease.
 
Whether it's building your resume, searching for the right job, or marketing yourself for the role you want, we've got you covered with tools like our FREE Chrome Extension, Job Tracker, and Resume Builder. 

Head over to www.tealhq.com to get started on your AI-powered resume.

These webinars will share similar information and tips every week, so if you're unable to join live, watch past episodes here on YouTube!

Join us for upcoming January webinars: https://lu.ma/4kp2slfz
